The relative gap is computed row by row for every line item, so an invoice with several line items yields several rows. The average quantity is the invoice-level average repeated on each row.
The overall average is the average of the per-invoice averages, so each invoice has equal weight.
The overall average is the average `product_quantity` across all line items, so invoices with more line items weigh more.
`product_quantity` is stored as VARCHAR, so it is cast to a number before averaging. A non-numeric value is either treated as missing or left uncast.

"Above" means greater than or equal to the overall average (>=).

The sort is descending by that difference. Rows where the difference is NULL come last, and ties are broken arbitrarily.

Line items with a NULL in any of the relevant columns are excluded from every calculation.

The gap is reported as an absolute value.

queries:
WITH inv_avg AS (
  SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT l.invoice_number,
         AVG(ABS(CAST(l.product_quantity AS REAL) - a.avg_qty) / a.avg_qty) AS avg_relative_gap
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items l
  JOIN inv_avg a ON l.invoice_number = a.invoice_number
  GROUP BY l.invoice_number
)
SELECT g.invoice_number, g.avg_relative_gap
FROM gaps g
JOIN inv_avg a ON g.invoice_number = a.invoice_number
WHERE a.avg_qty > (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) FROM inv_avg);
SELECT AVG(qty) AS avg_quantity_per_invoice,
       (SUM(cost) - SUM(total)) * 1.0 / SUM(total) AS relative_gap
FROM (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS qty,
         SUM(derived_product_cost) AS cost,
         SUM(derived_total_cost) AS total
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
)
WITH per_invoice AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty,
         AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
         AVG(derived_total_cost) AS avg_total_cost
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
)
SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS avg_quantity_per_invoice,
       AVG((avg_total_cost - avg_product_cost) / avg_product_cost) AS relative_gap
FROM per_invoice;
SELECT AVG(inv_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(derived_total_cost) AS inv_avg FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number);
SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) FROM Invoice_Line_Items;
